title: VRX Ingest Pack manifest
description: The top-level pack.json: who the pack is from, the entity tree it declares, and integrity checksums. One pack = one developer's proposed inventory, assembled offline and imported+vetted+activated by VRX root. Grounded in portal/lib/catalog.ts.

generatedBy.description: App + version that produced the pack (e.g. 'vrx-materials 0.1.0').

developer.description: The developer (person or holding company) the pack belongs to. Trust/brand flows DOWN the tree from here (the inheritance model).

nearAccount.description: Proposed on-chain account for this developer's Node. Owner-gated activation.

logo.description: Relative path to the developer/brand logo inside the pack.

companies.description: Legal entities a project may be registered under (a developer can have several). Buildings reference a companyId.

tree.description: The declared inheritance tree: developer -> companies -> complexes -> buildings. Children inherit shared facts (media, facilities) from parents; the import resolves inheritance.

id.description: Also the shared-media folder key (buildings inherit complexes/<id>/media).

companyId.description: Which company this complex is registered under.

buildings.description: Building ids whose building.json lives under buildings/<id>/. The building inherits this complex.

checksums.description: sha256 of each referenced file (relative path -> hex). Lets root verify the pack is intact + unchanged before activating; the root checksum can be anchored on-chain as an opaque provenance id.
